g.text: resolve -> fan-out DETECT per file -> barrier + report -> Q&A gate -> fan-out REMEDIATE per file -> summary
classify role: root / ancestor / child / local
1 file: inline in main loop - 2+ files: Workflow detect.js
fan-out = parallel(), one agent per file (NOT a pipeline)
Detection ONLY - no file is edited in this phase
barrier - parallel() join (the one sync point)
bucket totals: AUTO / DISCUSS / SPECIAL - per-file report
human-in-the-loop - decide each DISCUSS / SPECIAL finding
fan-out = parallel(), one lane per file (disjoint - no conflict)
re-run the audit to verify FAILs cleared (idempotent)
